title: The Painful Shoulder — Cuff Pain, Cuff Tears and the Tests That Tell Them Apart

hook.en: Most painful shoulders are not torn. Learn the tests that separate cuff-related pain from a real tear, and the ones that point to instability or the AC joint.
hook.ur: Zyada tar dardnak shoulders phate hue nahi hote. Woh tests seekhein jo cuff ke dard ko asli tear se alag karte hain, aur woh jo instability ya AC joint ki taraf ishara karte hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll examine a painful shoulder with a cluster for rotator cuff-related pain, spot the signs of a large tear and know when to refer.
goal.ur: End tak aap rotator cuff-related dard ke cluster se dardnak shoulder examine karenge, bari tear ki alamat pehchanenge aur jaanenge ke kab refer karna hai.

text.en: Most shoulder pain in adults is **rotator cuff-related shoulder pain**: a sensitive tendon, not a torn one. The tests ask different questions. The **painful arc**, **resisted external rotation** and **Hawkins-Kennedy** test ask whether the cuff and subacromial area are irritated. The **external rotation lag sign**, **drop-arm**, **Hornblower's sign** and the **belly-press** test ask whether a **tendon has torn**. The **apprehension** test and the **sulcus sign** ask about **instability**.
text.ur: Bohat se bado mein shoulder ka dard **rotator cuff-related shoulder pain** hota hai: sensitive tendon, phata hua nahi. Tests alag alag sawal poochhte hain. **Painful arc**, **resisted external rotation** aur **Hawkins-Kennedy** poochhte hain ke cuff aur subacromial area irritated hai ya nahi. **External rotation lag sign**, **drop-arm**, **Hornblower's sign** aur **belly-press** poochhte hain ke kya **tendon phata** hai. **Apprehension** aur **sulcus sign** **instability** ke baare mein poochhte hain.

text.en: Think of a rope fraying (irritated) versus a rope snapping (torn). A frayed rope still holds weight but hurts to lean on; a snapped rope cannot hold the load at all. The painful arc and Hawkins are about the fray. The lag signs and drop-arm test about the snap.
text.ur: Rassi ke ghisne (irritated) aur toot jane (phata) mein farq sochein. Ghisi hui rassi bojh sambhal leti hai lekin us par jhukna dardnak hota hai; toot-ti rassi bojh bilkul nahi uthati. Painful arc aur Hawkins ghisne ke baare mein hain. Lag signs aur drop-arm toot-ne ke baare mein.

steps.title: Look, ask and move
steps.detail: Take the history (age, injury, night pain, fear of the shoulder coming out). Check active and passive range. A stiff passive range points to a frozen shoulder or joint problem, not just the cuff. || Dekhein, poochhein aur hilayein

steps.title: Test for cuff-related pain
steps.detail: Use the painful arc, resisted external rotation and the Hawkins-Kennedy test. Two or three positive tests make cuff-related shoulder pain likely. || Cuff-related dard test karein

steps.title: Test for a tear
steps.detail: Look for a lag sign (external rotation lag), a positive drop-arm test, Hornblower's sign and weakness. Belly-press and lift-off test subscapularis. || Tear ke liye test karein

steps.title: Test for instability and the AC joint
steps.detail: Use apprehension and relocation for anterior instability and the sulcus sign for inferior laxity; cross-body adduction and tenderness for the AC joint. || Instability aur AC joint ke liye test karein

question.en: A 55-year-old cannot hold the arm in external rotation after you release it (lag sign) and cannot lower the abducted arm smoothly. What does this suggest?
question.ur: 55 saal ka patient chhorne ke baad bazoo ko external rotation mein nahi rok sakta (lag sign) aur abducted bazoo ko aahista neeche nahi la sakta. Yeh kya batata hai?

text.en: A large rotator cuff tear needing specialist assessment
text.ur: Bari rotator cuff tear jise specialist assessment chahiye

feedback.en: Yes — lag and drop-arm signs together suggest a large full-thickness tear.
feedback.ur: Haan — lag aur drop-arm signs milkar bari full-thickness tear ka ishara dete hain.

feedback.en: A frozen shoulder limits passive range; it does not give lag signs.
feedback.ur: Frozen shoulder passive range limit karti hai; lag signs nahi deti.

text.en: Simple rotator cuff-related pain managed with exercises only
text.ur: Sada rotator cuff-related dard jo sirf exercises se manage ho

feedback.en: These signs point beyond simple tendon irritation.
feedback.ur: Yeh signs sade tendon irritation se aage ki taraf ishara karte hain.

title.ur: Cuff irritated hai ya phati hui?

rows.en: Pain on the arc and on resisted movement
rows.ur: Arc aur resisted movement par dard

rows.en: Usually good once pain is accounted for
rows.ur: Dard ka hisab kar ke aksar acchi

text.en: **Pain tests ask "is it irritated?"; lag signs ask "is it torn?".** Do both groups and combine them with the history.
text.ur: **Pain tests poochhte hain "kya irritated hai?"; lag signs poochhte hain "kya phati hai?".** Dono groups karein aur history ke saath milayein.

text.en: **Calling it "impingement" from one test.** A positive Neer or Hawkins test fits many painful shoulders and does not prove a particular structure is pinched. Use the cluster and the history, and describe it as cuff-related shoulder pain.
text.ur: **Ek test se "impingement" kehna.** Positive Neer ya Hawkins bohat se dardnak shoulders mein hota hai aur yeh sabit nahi karta ke koi khaas structure dab raha hai. Cluster aur history istemal karein, aur ise cuff-related shoulder pain kahein.

question.ur: Kaun sa test subscapularis ko assess karta hai?

feedback.ur: Yeh zyada tar supraspinatus test karta hai.

feedback.en: That tests the posterior cuff (teres minor and infraspinatus).
feedback.ur: Yeh posterior cuff (teres minor aur infraspinatus) test karta hai.

feedback.en: Yes — an elbow that drops back or a flexed wrist shows subscapularis weakness.
feedback.ur: Haan — kohni ka peechay girna ya wrist ka mudna subscapularis ki kamzori dikhata hai.

question.en: A young rugby player feels the shoulder will come out when it is abducted and turned outwards. Which test confirms the pattern?
question.ur: Ek nojawan rugby player ko lagta hai ke abduct aur bahar ghumane par shoulder nikal jayega. Kaun sa test is pattern ki tasdeeq karta hai?

feedback.en: That mainly points to a subacromial cause.
feedback.ur: Yeh zyada tar subacromial wajah ki taraf ishara karta hai.

feedback.en: Yes — apprehension that eases with a backward force on the humeral head points to anterior instability.
feedback.ur: Haan — peechay ki force se jo apprehension kam ho woh anterior instability ki taraf ishara hai.

feedback.en: The sulcus sign tests inferior laxity, not anterior instability.
feedback.ur: Sulcus sign inferior laxity test karta hai, anterior instability nahi.

text.en: **Start with the plan, not the label.** For cuff-related shoulder pain, offer education and graded loading of the shoulder and shoulder blade. For signs of a large tear after trauma or in an active person, arrange imaging and a specialist opinion early. For instability, build strength and control and refer if it keeps coming out.
text.ur: **Label se nahi, plan se shuru karein.** Cuff-related shoulder pain ke liye education aur shoulder aur shoulder blade ki graded loading dein. Chot ke baad ya active insaan mein bari tear ki alamat par jaldi imaging aur specialist ray ka intezam karein. Instability ke liye taqat aur control banayein aur agar baar baar nikle to refer karein.

question.en: Why might a patient have pain on every shoulder test yet a normal scan?
question.ur: Patient ko har shoulder test par dard ho lekin scan normal ho, aisa kyun?

answer.en: Because pain in the shoulder does not need a tear. A sensitive tendon, an irritated nervous system or a changed load can hurt on movement even when the scan is normal, and scans often show changes in people without pain. The tests tell you what hurts and what is weak, and the plan comes from the whole picture.
answer.ur: Kyunke shoulder ke dard ke liye tear zaroori nahi. Sensitive tendon, irritated nervous system ya badla hua load harkat par dard de sakte hain chahe scan normal ho, aur scans aksar bagair dard walon mein bhi tabdeeli dikhate hain. Tests batate hain ke kya dukhta hai aur kya kamzor hai, aur plan poori tasveer se banta hai.

beats.patient: A 62-year-old retired builder has had three months of night pain. He cannot lower the abducted arm smoothly and the arm drifts back from external rotation when you release it.
beats.assessment: These findings point to a full-thickness posterior cuff tear.
beats.treatment: Explain the likely tear, protect the shoulder from heavy loading, arrange imaging and a specialist opinion, and keep the other joints moving.
beats.reassess: The scan shows a large tear; an orthopaedic review is arranged, with exercises kept gentle while he waits.

text.en: **Refer urgently** for a hot, swollen joint with fever (infection), a deformed shoulder after a fall (dislocation or fracture), sudden loss of active lifting after an injury, or shoulder pain with chest pain, breathlessness or a cancer history. These are not for exercise alone.
text.ur: **Fori refer karein** bukhar ke saath garam sooji hui joint (infection), girne ke baad badshakl shoulder (dislocation ya fracture), chot ke baad achanak active lifting ka khatam ho jana, ya shoulder ke dard ke saath seene ka dard, saans phoolna ya cancer ki history. Yeh sirf exercise ke liye nahi.

summary.en: Pain tests (painful arc, resisted external rotation, Hawkins-Kennedy) ask whether the cuff is irritated; lag signs and the drop-arm test ask whether it is torn.
summary.ur: Pain tests (painful arc, resisted external rotation, Hawkins-Kennedy) poochhte hain ke cuff irritated hai ya nahi; lag signs aur drop-arm test poochhte hain ke kya phati hai.

summary.en: Use a cluster, not one test, and use belly-press or lift-off for the subscapularis, apprehension for anterior instability and cross-body adduction for the AC joint.
summary.ur: Ek test nahi, cluster istemal karein, aur subscapularis ke liye belly-press ya lift-off, anterior instability ke liye apprehension aur AC joint ke liye cross-body adduction.

summary.en: Treat cuff-related pain with education and graded loading; refer early for signs of a large tear, instability that keeps recurring, infection or red flags.
summary.ur: Cuff-related dard ka ilaaj education aur graded loading se karein; bari tear ki alamat, baar baar hone wali instability, infection ya red flags par jaldi refer karein.

front.en: What does the external rotation lag sign suggest?
front.ur: External rotation lag sign kya batata hai?

back.en: A full-thickness tear of the posterior rotator cuff.
back.ur: Posterior rotator cuff ki full-thickness tear.

front.en: Which test is used for the subscapularis when the lift-off position is too painful?
front.ur: Lift-off ki position bohat dardnak ho to subscapularis ke liye kaun sa test?

front.en: What does a positive apprehension test mean?
front.ur: Positive apprehension test ka kya matlab hai?

back.en: Fear that the shoulder will come out, relieved by relocation: anterior instability.
back.ur: Shoulder ke nikalne ka dar, jo relocation se kam ho: anterior instability.

back.en: Because one positive test does not prove a particular structure is pinched; use rotator cuff-related shoulder pain.
back.ur: Kyunke ek positive test sabit nahi karta ke koi khaas structure dab raha hai; rotator cuff-related shoulder pain kahein.

note.en: Practise every shoulder test with its pitfalls.
note.ur: Har shoulder test ko uski ghaltiyon ke saath practise karein.
